description: This file implements a service class in Java for reading report mailing job configuration data from a database within the Apache Fineract framework. It provides methods to retrieve all configurations or a specific configuration by name, utilizing JDBC template queries and mapping the results to data objects.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobConfigurationReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service for reading report mailing job configurations, interfacing with the database through JdbcTemplate.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobConfigurationMapper
classes.description: Private static class that maps SQL result set rows to ReportMailingJobConfigurationData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllReportMailingJobConfigurations
methods.description: Fetches all report mailing job configuration data from the database.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJobConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches a specific report mailing job configuration by name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: reportMailingJobConfigurationSchema
methods.description: Returns the SQL fragment defining the schema (columns and table) for report mailing job configuration.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a single row of the SQL result set to a ReportMailingJobConfigurationData object.
